title: URL and typosquat spotting
description: Compare lookalike hostnames, punycode, and risky TLDs against the real Northwind and PayPal-style brands used in this lab. All hostnames are simulated.
learningObjectives: Detect digit and homoglyph substitutions in brand domains
Read punycode (xn--) as a decoding step, not as proof of safety
Flag newly popular throwaway TLDs used in templates
Trace a static redirect chain listed on the sample

steps.title: Homoglyph hostname
steps.prompt: Which hostname in the invoice sample is a lookalike of paypal.com?

steps.title: Punycode
steps.prompt: What is the punycode form stored for the Cyrillic lookalike URL?

steps.title: TLD
steps.prompt: Which TLD on the invoice lure is in the risky set {xyz, top, click}?

hints: A Latin 'l' and a digit '1' are easy to miss at small type sizes.
The Engine artifacts panel lists punycode even when the rendered link shows Unicode.
